faq_site_visit_why_q: Why does SokoniMax require an in-person physical store visit before I can sell?
faq_site_visit_why_a: To prevent spam accounts, counterfeit listings, and delivery disputes, SokoniMax requires every merchant to undergo an in-person physical premises inspection. A certified staff member visits your store, verifies your physical inventory and presence, and logs official coordinates and storefront photographs before your account can be approved for selling.
faq_site_visit_request_q: How do I request a site verification visit?
faq_site_visit_request_a: Call or message our official verification hotline directly using the buttons provided above. Provide our staff with your shop name, physical street address or landmark, and preferred inspection hours. Our verification field team will schedule and execute the visit.
faq_site_visit_what_happens_q: What happens during the physical site visit?
faq_site_visit_what_happens_a: A certified SokoniMax staff member visits your physical shop. They will: 1) Verify that your shop exists and is open for business; 2) Take storefront and interior stock photos; 3) Note precise GPS coordinates; and 4) Submit the official inspection report to the SokoniMax administration for review.
faq_site_visit_review_time_q: How long does admin review take, and how will I know I'm approved?
faq_site_visit_review_time_a: Once our staff submits your physical visit report, our administration reviews the evidence within 24–48 hours. When approved, you will receive an instant notification in your account, and your store status in Settings will show 'Site Verified ✓'. You can then proceed immediately to choose your subscription tier and launch your store.
faq_site_visit_no_shop_q: Can I sell without a physical shop or inventory?
faq_site_visit_no_shop_a: Currently, SokoniMax requires all verified merchants to operate an active, verifiable business or physical workshop/store in Tanzania. This ensures accurate pickup hub logistics, verified seller ratings, and 100% buyer trust.
faq_ad_badge_q: What does the 'AD' (Sponsored) badge on a product mean?
faq_ad_badge_a: Products displaying the 'AD' (Sponsored) badge are promoted listings. Sellers pay an advertising fee to boost their product's visibility across search results and category feeds. All sponsored items must comply with SokoniMax seller verification standards, accurate product conditions (New, Used, Refurbished), and merchant policies.
faq_ad_rankings_q: How do sponsored ads affect search rankings and pricing?
faq_ad_rankings_a: Sponsored ads give items prominent placement in product carousels and feeds, but prices and product details remain set directly by the merchant without any hidden buyer fees. Sponsored products are clearly marked with the 'AD' badge for complete transparency.

faq_q_1: What is OKO (Uzaspea) and how does it work?
faq_a_1: We are a next-generation marketplace connecting buyers with verified sellers. Whether you're looking for high-quality electronics, services, or everyday items, our platform provides a secure environment with built-in buyer protection, independent product inspections, and seamless messaging.
faq_q_2: How do I contact customer support?
faq_a_2: You can reach out to our support team directly from the 'Help Center' dashboard. Simply fill out the 'Contact Support & Give Feedback' form, and our team will get back to you promptly. You can track the status of all your inquiries right from your dashboard.
faq_q_3: How do I become a Verified Seller or upgrade my account?
faq_a_3: To build trust with buyers, you can upgrade to a Seller Pro or Business account. Go to your Profile Dashboard and click on 'Upgrade Account'. Verification involves a brief identity and business check. Verified sellers receive a distinctive badge and increased visibility.
faq_q_4: Can I have multiple people managing my store?
faq_a_4: Yes! If you are a Business or Seller Pro, you can use our 'Teams' feature. Navigate to 'Teams' in your dashboard to invite staff members, assign them specific roles (like Inventory Manager or Support Agent), and securely manage your business together without sharing passwords.
faq_q_5: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
faq_a_5: On the login screen, click 'Forgot Password'. Enter the email address associated with your account, and we will send you a secure link to reset your password. If you don't receive the email, please check your spam folder.
faq_q_6: Is it safe to pay through the platform?
faq_a_6: Absolutely. All transactions are securely encrypted. We hold funds in escrow until the buyer confirms receipt and satisfaction with the item. This ensures that sellers are motivated to deliver exactly what was promised, and buyers are protected from fraud.
faq_q_7: How do Lipa Numbers work for sellers?
faq_a_7: Lipa Numbers allow buyers to pay you directly via mobile money (like M-PESA). As a seller, you can configure your official Lipa Number in your Billing settings. When a buyer checks out, our system seamlessly processes the mobile payment and automatically updates the order status.
faq_q_8: How can I track the status of my order?
faq_a_8: Once you place an order, you can track its progress in the 'My Orders' section of your dashboard. You will see real-time updates as the seller prepares, ships, and delivers your item. We'll also notify you via push notifications for major updates.
faq_q_9: What happens if my order arrives damaged or not as described?
faq_a_9: If there is an issue with your order, do not mark it as 'Received'. Instead, immediately open a Dispute from the order details page. Our resolution team will step in, review the evidence, and facilitate a return or refund if the seller violates our policies.
faq_a_10: For high-value items like electronics or vehicles, buyers can request a Third-Party Inspection. A certified, independent Inspector will physically examine the item, test its functionality, and provide a detailed report before you finalize the purchase.
faq_q_11: How do I become a Certified Inspector?
faq_a_11: If you are an expert in evaluating specific types of products (like cars, phones, or machinery), you can apply to be an Inspector. Go to your dashboard and submit an Inspector Application. Our team will vet your credentials before activating your inspector profile.
